record.title: DfCM SELECT DEVELOP R45 cumulative-family learning
record.body: Durable novel learning: cumulative semantic families make fixed total-cardinality verifier contracts anti-compositional. The R43 verifier asserted exactly 50 sensors, but R45 lawfully appended another 50, producing 100 while preserving the original family. General verifier law should constrain identity, contiguity, family-local cardinality, mutation prohibition, and semantic invariants without freezing the total extension surface. Independently, timeout-law caught a workflow reliability defect even while all four real-ggen qualification shards and aggregate pack qualification were green, proving these courts cover different failure dimensions. Future consumer factories should therefore pair cumulative-extension compatibility courts with bounded execution courts.
